pages.title: Clinics
pages.content:
(Clinics)

Clinics

One clinic for each working day

Monday is the Rhythm Clinic (palpitations, atrial fibrillation, Holter fitting). Tuesday is the Blood Pressure Clinic (home readings, 24-hour monitor). Wednesday is the Heart Failure Clinic (breathlessness, swelling, medication review). Thursday is Imaging Day (echocardiogram, stress echo). Friday is the Prevention Clinic (family history, cholesterol, return to sport or work).

Consultations run from 08:30 to 17:00 every weekday, inside our opening hours of Monday to Friday 08:00–17:30.

Book a visit↗

pages.title: First visit
pages.content:
(First visit)

First visit

Ninety minutes, timed to the quarter hour

Check-in 10 minutes, nurse, blood pressure and ECG 15, echocardiogram 30, cardiologist 25, plan and booking 10. Please bring photo ID, your medication list and any previous ECGs or letters. Results are reviewed within 14 days.

Book a visit↗

pages.title: Follow-up
pages.content:
(Follow-up)

Follow-up

We keep the next date for you

Book online at any time (answered within one working day), by phone on +1 555 0142 from 08:00 to 17:30, or at the follow-up desk from 13:00 to 16:00 on weekdays. Saturday 09:00–12:30 is for follow-ups only. Follow-ups run every 3, 6 or 12 months as agreed with your cardiologist.

Book a visit↗

pages.title: Tests and fees
pages.content:
(Tests & fees)

Tests and fees

Fixed prices in USD

First consultation with ECG $180, echocardiogram $240, exercise stress test $220, 24-hour Holter monitor $160, 24-hour blood pressure monitor $120, follow-up consultation $95, heart check $420. Itemised receipts for insurance claims on request.

Book a visit↗

pages.title: Stories
pages.content:
(Stories)

Stories

Patients, in their words

Walter, 58, bus driver: palpitations on early shifts; Holter fitted on a Monday, reviewed the next week. Hana, 41, teacher: high readings at school; 24-hour monitor on a Tuesday, a plan with Dr. Ribeiro. Joseph, 72, retired joiner: Heart Failure Clinic every three months; Jonas calls between visits. Stories shared with permission; names changed; every heart is different.

Book a visit↗

pages.title: About
pages.content:
(About)

About

A heart keeps working hours. So do we.

Dr. Elena Varga founded Ibuki Cardiology in 2011 at 14 Harbour Lane in Northbridge as an independent outpatient clinic built around predictable, unhurried care. Seven people work here, from cardiologists and a sonographer to the follow-up desk and the patient coordinator.

Book a visit↗

posts.title: Thursday imaging slots now start at 08:30
posts.excerpt: Imaging Day opens earlier so a first-visit echo can be booked before the working day starts.
posts.content: Imaging Day on Thursday now begins at 08:30. That gives first-visit patients an echo slot before most workdays start, with the cardiologist reviewing the same morning.

posts.title: What a Holter monitor feels like for 24 hours
posts.excerpt: A small recorder, a few leads, and a normal day: what to expect when a Holter is fitted.
posts.content: A Holter is fitted on Monday during the Rhythm Clinic. You wear a small recorder for 24 hours and keep a note of any symptoms. It is returned the next day and reviewed within fourteen days.

posts.title: Bringing home blood pressure readings that help
posts.excerpt: Two readings, morning and evening, for a week: how to make home numbers useful.
posts.content: Sit for five minutes, take two readings a minute apart, and write them down morning and evening for seven days. Bring the notebook to the Tuesday Blood Pressure Clinic.

posts.title: Saturday follow-ups: how the morning runs
posts.excerpt: Saturday 09:00–12:30 is for follow-ups only: a short, unhurried morning.
posts.content: Saturday follow-ups are 20 minutes each and booked ahead, so the desk is calm. New patients are seen from Monday to Friday.

posts.title: Returning to sport after a heart check
posts.excerpt: The Friday Prevention Clinic helps plan a safe return to running, cycling or work.
posts.content: A stress test, a conversation and a plan: the Prevention Clinic on Friday is built for people who want to return to activity with a clear picture of their heart.

posts.title: Meet the follow-up desk
posts.excerpt: Jonas Berg and Amara Diallo on the calls that happen between visits.
posts.content: Jonas Berg runs the follow-up desk from 13:00 to 16:00 on weekdays. He calls patients between visits and when results are in.
